title: Fight effects in a pocket land on its floor
description: A fight with no room where it starts goes on in a pocket of the place, built far from it (src/pocket.ts). Its particles land, bounce and leave marks on the pocket's own floor and walls (src/arena.ts pocketWorld, effects setFightStage), not on the place's: on the tower's third ring that floor stood almost seven metres over the fighters, and the drops, sparks and frost went there. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: const g = window.gerard.game, foes = g.fighterIds().filter(f => !f.party); window.__foe = foes[Math.floor(foes.length / 2)].id; const p = g.fighterAt(window.__foe); g.frame({ x: p.x, y: p.y + .5, z: p.z }, 2.2)

steps.caption: The fight in a pocket of the tower's third ring, framed on the middle foe
Baja: the circle at its feet and the red drops settling on the pocket's floor round them

steps.eval: const g = window.gerard.game, p = g.fighterAt(window.__foe); g.effects.impact({ x: p.x, y: p.y + .5, z: p.z }, { x: p.x - 3, y: p.y + .5, z: p.z }, 1.4, { feet: p })

steps.caption: A blow: the sparks fly on through the foe, level with it
Lluvia de escarcha: the frost ring lies on the floor at its feet and the chips settle on it
